stories.headline: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; CFO Colette Kress named interim chief, Harvey Jones chair

key_facts.fact: Nvidia's board announced on November 12, 2026 that Jensen Huang resigned as President, CEO and board member, effective immediately.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately.

key_facts.fact: An 8-K filing says the board accepted Huang's resignation on November 11 and appointed CFO Colette Kress, 59, as interim CEO while it searches for a successor; she keeps the CFO role.
key_facts.excerpt: On November 11, 2026, the Board of Directors ... accepted the resignation of Jen-Hsun Huang ... the Board appointed NVIDIA's Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Colette M. Kress, age 59, to serve as interim Chief Executive Officer

key_facts.fact: Harvey C. Jones, a director since 1993 and former Synopsys CEO, became Nvidia's first-ever Chair of the Board.
key_facts.excerpt: The Board of Directors appointed Harvey C. Jones as its first-ever Chair of the Board ... including serving as Chief Executive Officer and Executive Chairman of Synopsys.

key_facts.fact: The board will consider internal and external candidates for permanent CEO, and Nvidia will still report Q3 fiscal 2027 results on November 17.
key_facts.excerpt: The Board is initiating a search for a permanent Chief Executive Officer and will consider internal and external candidates. ... NVIDIA will report its third-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results on Tuesday, November 17

key_facts.fact: The resignation came days after Huang admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, and after a New York Times report of an affair with an Nvidia executive who reported to him.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia's board had gathered to discuss Huang's future after revelations that he was having an affair with a former Megaspeed executive suspected of being a Chinese government agent. The New York Times reported Wednesday that Huang also had an affair with an Nvidia executive who reported to him.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia stock fell 4.34% to close at $166.19 on Thursday; neocloud Nebius fell 16.84% and CoreWeave 6.86%.
key_facts.excerpt: On Thursday, shares of neocloud companies, Nebius Group N.V. (NASDAQ:NBIS) slumped 16.84%, while CoreWeave, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWV) declined 6.86% ... Meanwhile, Nvidia stock fell 4.34% to close at $166.19.

stories.headline: Senate Banking chair asks Huang and Lutnick to testify on Nvidia chip exports; Lutnick agrees

key_facts.fact: Senate Banking Chairman Tim Scott sent letters on Thursday asking ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to appear on December 3 and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick on December 10.
key_facts.excerpt: Scott (R-S.C.) in letters Thursday asked Huang to appear before the committee Dec. 3 and Lutnick on Dec. 10, citing national security concerns

key_facts.fact: The letter warns the committee is prepared to use subpoenas if they do not appear voluntarily, citing its jurisdiction over export controls on Nvidia's advanced semiconductors.
key_facts.excerpt: His letter to Huang says the committee has "jurisdiction over matters relating to 'export controls,' including their application to NVIDIA's exports of advanced semiconductors."

key_facts.fact: A Lutnick spokesperson said he has proactively agreed to appear voluntarily before the Banking Committee.
key_facts.excerpt: "Secretary Lutnick has proactively agreed to appear voluntarily before the Banking Committee to address their questions," Kristen Eichamer, a spokesperson for Lutnick, told NBC News on Thursday.

key_facts.fact: Megaspeed, the Singapore-based company where Huang's alleged-spy partner was an executive, bought over $4.8 billion of advanced Nvidia AI chips over two years.
key_facts.excerpt: Huang has acknowledged an affair with an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that has bought over $4.8 billion of advanced Nvidia AI chips over the past two years.

key_facts.fact: Three House committee chairs separately told Huang and Nvidia General Counsel Tim Teter to appear for closed-door interviews on December 1 and 2 or face subpoenas.
key_facts.excerpt: Separately, three House committee chairs told Huang and Nvidia General Counsel Tim Teter to appear for closed-door interviews on December 1 and 2, or face subpoenas.

key_facts.fact: Two people told Reuters the White House was discussing whether to push Lutnick out over his handling of Nvidia's China exports.
key_facts.excerpt: Two people familiar with the matter told Reuters that the White House was discussing whether to push Lutnick out.

key_facts.fact: Scott also said the administration must inform his committee of any changes to export regulations with an explanation of their intent and rationale.
key_facts.excerpt: Mr. Scott said the administration must inform his committee of any changes to export regulations with an "explanation of their intent and rationale."

stories.headline: SpaceX plans $74B in AI supercompute campuses in Texas and Arizona, picks Terafab chip site

key_facts.fact: SpaceX said on Thursday it plans more than $74 billion in supercompute investment: over $24 billion at Starbase, Texas and roughly $50 billion in Cochise County, Arizona.
key_facts.excerpt: a major new supercompute facility at Starbase in the Rio Grande Valley in Texas, and a second campus in Cochise County, Arizona. Together, they represent more than $74 billion in planned American investment

key_facts.fact: The Texas facility will generate its own electricity rather than draw from the public grid; a public hearing notice describes a gas-fired power plant paired with the compute facility.
key_facts.excerpt: A public hearing notice reviewed by Reuters described the project as a gas-fired power plant paired with the compute facility, with $24 billion covering initial phases

key_facts.fact: The Arizona campus is expected to create about 5,500 construction jobs and 1,000 permanent jobs, use dry cooling with no planned industrial groundwater use, and still needs county approval.
key_facts.excerpt: In Arizona, SpaceX plans to build a $50 billion campus in Cochise County, which will create 5,500 construction jobs and 1,000 permanent jobs, the company said. The Arizona project still requires approval from the county.

key_facts.fact: SpaceX committed $220 million to expand Brownsville's water and wastewater infrastructure, adding about 20 million gallons per day of capacity.
key_facts.excerpt: We're also committing $220 million to expand Brownsville's water and wastewater infrastructure, helping to create 20 million gallons per day of additional water capacity

key_facts.fact: The announcement came less than a week after the Brownsville City Commission approved a 90-day moratorium on data center development in the city.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX's announcement comes less than a week after the Brownsville City Commission unanimously approved a 90-day moratorium on data center development in the city.

key_facts.fact: SpaceX also announced that Terafab, its chip fab effort with Tesla combining logic, memory and advanced packaging, will be built in Grimes County, Texas.
key_facts.excerpt: And today, we are announcing that Terafab will be built in Grimes County, Texas. The facility will be an advanced semiconductor fab

stories.headline: Nscale's amended IPO filing: $1.69B loss, $5.5B debt, more financing needed for Anthropic build

key_facts.fact: Nvidia-backed neocloud Nscale released an updated US IPO prospectus on Thursday showing a $1.69 billion net loss on $307.5 million revenue, up 1,344% year over year.
key_facts.excerpt: The company had a third-quarter net loss of $1.69 billion on $307.5 million in revenue, which was up 1,344% year over year, according to an updated prospectus

key_facts.fact: Nscale said it will need additional financing for 2027 commitments after a major Nvidia chip order to fulfill a $44.6 billion contract with Anthropic, and has no binding commitments for that financing.
key_facts.excerpt: Nscale said it will need "additional financing" to meet its 2027 financial commitments after placing a major Nvidia chip order to fulfill a $44.6 billion contract with Anthropic.

key_facts.fact: The September filing had said Nscale had funds for at least 12 months; that sentence was removed and replaced with a warning that some new capital commitments cannot be deferred, reduced or cancelled.
key_facts.excerpt: Den setningen er nå fjernet, og denne er lagt til: «Noen av de nye kapitalforpliktelsene kan ikke utsettes, reduseres eller kanselleres av oss.

key_facts.fact: Total debt reached $5.5 billion at end-September, up from $78.9 million at the start of the year; cash stood at $3.6 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Ved utgangen av september hadde Nscale en samlet gjeld på 5,5 milliarder dollar, opp fra bare 78,9 millioner dollar ved årsskiftet. Kontantbeholdningen var på 3,6 milliarder dollar.

key_facts.fact: The first building at the Monarch campus in West Virginia, where Anthropic is the customer, is estimated at $10-10.5 billion for data center and power plus $21-22 billion for GPUs and equipment.
key_facts.excerpt: Bare det første bygget på Monarch-campuset i West Virginia, der Anthropic skal være kunde, er anslått å koste 10–10,5 milliarder dollar ... ytterligere 21–22 milliarder dollar til grafikkprosessorer og annet utstyr.

key_facts.fact: Nscale plans to list on the NYSE under ticker NSCL with Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan and Morgan Stanley as lead bookrunners; it had targeted a valuation of up to $35 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan og Morgan Stanley leder noteringen. ... Nscale har tidligere hatt planer om å hente opptil 3 milliarder dollar gjennom børsnoteringen, med en verdsettelse på opptil 35 milliarder dollar.

stories.headline: Cerebras beats Q3 estimates, signs Microsoft as third hyperscaler customer; stock jumps 17%

key_facts.fact: Cerebras reported Q3 core revenue of $230.9 million, up 70% from $135.7 million, versus $214.7 million expected; adjusted EPS was 12 cents versus an expected 14-cent loss.
key_facts.excerpt: Earnings per share: 12 cents adjusted vs. loss of 14 cents expected; Core revenue: $230.9 million vs. $214.7 million expected. Cerebras' core revenue grew 70% from $135.7 million

key_facts.fact: Cerebras announced Microsoft as a customer, its third hyperscaler after AWS and Oracle; CEO Andrew Feldman said revenue from the deal begins in Q1 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: we signed an important cloud deal with Microsoft, which along with the AWS and Oracle announcements previously made, bring us to three hyperscalers who have chosen to leverage the Cerebras platform

key_facts.fact: Core cloud revenue rose 272% year over year to $145 million; core hardware revenue was $86 million; cloud growth is capped by data center capacity until it ramps in December.
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue from our core cloud and other services was also a record, increasing by 272% year-over-year to $145 million. ... Our ramp in cloud revenue is limited entirely by our data center capacity

key_facts.fact: Cerebras raised Q4 core revenue guidance to $310-330 million and full-year 2026 to $940-960 million, and still expects revenue to triple in 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: For the fourth quarter, Cerebras raised its guidance to core revenue of $310 million to $330 million ... For full-year 2026, it raised its core revenue forecast to $940 million to $960 million

key_facts.fact: Executives said data center delays have put portions of Cerebras' OpenAI contract behind schedule.
key_facts.excerpt: executives said data center delays have put portions of its OpenAI contract behind schedule.

key_facts.fact: Shares rose about 17% in extended trading after the report.
key_facts.excerpt: The stock soared 17% in extended trading.

stories.headline: Samsung in talks to buy US data-center cooling maker Modine; shares jump 28% after hours

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics is in talks to acquire Modine Manufacturing, a maker of data center cooling systems, in a deal that could come together in the coming weeks, Bloomberg reported Thursday.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung is in talks to acquire Modine Manufacturing, a US-listed maker of cooling systems for data centres, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday (Nov 12) ... a potential deal that could come together as soon as the coming weeks

key_facts.fact: Modine had a market value of $5.6 billion and its shares surged about 29% in extended trading; no final decision has been made and another suitor could emerge.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of Modine surged 29 per cent in extended trading following the report. The company had a market value of US$5.6 billion ... No final decision has been made and the talks could still fall apart

key_facts.fact: Modine's data center segment revenue rose 95% year over year to $439.7 million in its latest quarter.
key_facts.excerpt: Third-quarter revenue in its data center segment rose 95% from a year earlier to $439.7 million

key_facts.fact: Seoul Economic Daily estimates a full takeover at $7.5-8 billion, which could top the roughly $8 billion Samsung paid for Harman in 2017 as its largest deal.
key_facts.excerpt: the expected acquisition price is estimated at $7.5 billion to $8 billion ... If the price exceeds the roughly $8 billion Samsung paid for Harman in 2017, the deal could become the largest merger and acquisition in Samsung Electronics' history.

key_facts.fact: Samsung bought German HVAC firm FläktGroup for about 1.5 billion euros last year to enter the HVAC market.
key_facts.excerpt: Last year, Samsung Electronics invested approximately 1.5 billion euros ... to acquire the German company FlaktGroup, launching an offensive in the global HVAC market.

stories.headline: Chinese AI server maker xFusion clears Shenzhen review for $1.2B ChiNext IPO

key_facts.fact: xFusion Digital Technologies cleared the Shenzhen Stock Exchange listing committee review for its ChiNext IPO in a filing dated November 12.
key_facts.excerpt: The exchange's listing committee said in the filing dated November 12 that xFusion met requirements on share issuance, listing and disclosure

key_facts.fact: The Zhengzhou-based company aims to raise 8 billion yuan ($1.2 billion) by issuing up to 220.08 million new shares, with Citic Securities as sponsor.
key_facts.excerpt: The Zhengzhou-based company aims to raise 8 billion yuan ($1.2 billion) by issuing as many as 220.08 million new shares in the share sale ... Citic Securities Co. is sponsoring the listing.

key_facts.fact: The committee asked xFusion to explain its gross margin trend and whether growth can be sustained, citing compute demand, customer capex and customer/supplier concentration.
key_facts.excerpt: The committee asked xFusion to explain the trend in its gross margin and whether growth in its operating performance could be sustained ... It cited changes in demand for computing capacity, capital spending by downstream customers

key_facts.fact: xFusion, founded in 2021 and ultimately controlled by Henan province's state assets regulator, plans RMB 4.08 billion of proceeds for next-generation computing infrastructure; CSRC registration is still pending.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded in Zhengzhou in 2021 and ultimately controlled by Henan province's state-owned assets regulator ... RMB 4.08 billion to next-generation computing-infrastructure research and industrialization
